name: Split Flap
description: A departures board of split-flap tiles, each flap parted across the middle and showing a colored square, disc, triangle, bar or a solid flap.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 48.6%, transparent 48.6% 51.8%, #000 51.8%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 48.6%, transparent 48.6% 51.8%, #000 51.8%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6% 8%; border-radius: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6% 8%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @p(inset(0% round 10%), inset(0% 0% 50% 0% round 10% 10% 0% 0%), circle(30% at 50% 50%), polygon(50% 14%, 86% 82%, 14% 82%), inset(22% 22%), inset(40% 12%), polygon(50% 12%, 88% 50%, 50% 88%, 12% 50%)); clip-path: @p(inset(0% round 10%), inset(0% 0% 50% 0% round 10% 10% 0% 0%), circle(30% at 50% 50%), polygon(50% 14%, 86% 82%, 14% 82%), inset(22% 22%), inset(40% 12%), polygon(50% 12%, 88% 50%, 50% 88%, 12% 50%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
